title: Single Rewind-Phase Transition
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word and let $i<|x|$. From state $1$, with the input head at position $i+1$, all bits of $x$ copied onto the work tape, and the work head at cell $|x|$, one step of the three-state palindrome machine reaches state $1$ with the input head at position $i$. The work tape and work-head position are unchanged, and the output remains empty.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$ and $i < n$. From the configuration of the
three-state palindrome machine on input $x$ in rewind state with input head at
cell $i+1$, all $n$ bits copied, and work head at cell $n$, one transition moves
the input head left to cell $i$ and changes nothing else: the state, the copied
work tape, and the work head position are preserved.
